classes.name: Ghost Fishing Net
classes.acoustic_signature: Porous diffuse backscatter with extended trailing shadow

classes.name: Chemical / Industrial Drum
classes.acoustic_signature: Sharp specular reflection peak + steep rectangular shadow

classes.name: Lost Cargo Container (TEU)
classes.acoustic_signature: High-intensity linear edge return + wide rectangular shadow

classes.name: Plastic Debris Raft / Tyres
classes.acoustic_signature: Semi-diffuse mottled return with irregular boundary shadow

classes.name: Submerged Shipwreck / Metallic Structure
classes.acoustic_signature: Massive multi-point specular array + structural acoustic occlusions

classes.name: Protected Coral Habitat (Biogenic)
classes.acoustic_signature: High-rugosity complex volumetric scattering without sharp geometric edges
